findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The first HeatChill step incorrectly represents the preheated block as an initial reaction-heating operation before charging. Reaction heating is already represented after substrate addition. Preserve block preheating and reactor placement as unmapped details rather than a separate initial reaction step.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is omitted. It cannot be represented by an allowed operation and should be retained in unmapped_actions.

findings.quote: chromatographic separation with silica gel (20% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)
findings.message: The purification evidence retains the conditions, but the method field omits the specified silica gel and eluent composition.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: The block was already preheated when the microreactor was placed into it after capping. Block preheating and physical placement are not separately representable by the allowed operations; reaction heating is represented in the subsequent HeatChill step.
